methodology.notes: Round-robin per (image, impl); cooldown sleep between every cell to keep the CPU near baseline temperature. Per-pass C++ medians come from rfdetr-cli bench's internal median over `iters` timed iterations after `warmup`. Python per-iter ms are trimmed top+bottom 10% before computing the in-cell median, then per-pass medians are aggregated as above. The IQR reported per cell measures pass-to-pass stability, not within-call jitter, so it's a direct thermal/scheduler-jitter probe.
